clauses.title: Scope – Gives specifications
clauses.text: 1.   Scope -  Gives specifications for hexagon nuts with thread diameters from M5 to M64 inclusive and product grade C.

clauses.title: Dimensions – M5, M6,
clauses.text: 2.   Dimensions - M5, M6, M8, M10,  M12,  M16,  M20, M24, M30, M36, M42, M48, M56 and M64.
